name: Customer Call
description: Discovery, sales, or support calls with a customer or prospect.

sections.title: About the Customer
sections.instruction: Who they are, their role, company, and context that matters

sections.title: Pain Points & Goals
sections.instruction: Problems they described and what they are trying to achieve, in their words where possible

sections.title: Current Setup
sections.instruction: Tools, process, or workaround they use today, and what they dislike about it

sections.title: Objections & Questions
sections.instruction: Concerns, objections, or questions they raised and how they were answered

sections.title: Commercials & Timeline
sections.instruction: Budget, pricing, decision process, stakeholders, and timeline mentioned

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: Agreed follow-ups with owner and date
